text.p: In-Flight Corp and its wholly-owned subsidiary In-Flight Phone International Inc today filed for Chapter 11 protection in the U.S. Bankruptcy court in Delaware.
The company listed assets of $128.7 million and liabilities of $257.2 million.
The company also listed its fixed liquidated unsecured debt as $335.4 million with no explanation for the difference between that figure and the liabilities.
In-Flight Corp is controlled by IFP Holdings Inc and according to court papers "MCI has the potential to control the debtor through its control of IFP Holdings."

In-Flight Corp, which is based in Oakbrook Terrace, lll., developed and operates interactive air-to-ground and ground-to-air telephone telecommunications and entertainment systems for use in commerical airplanes.
Among the 20 largest unsecured claims are $285 million in senior discount notes due 2002 held by Marine Midland Bank and $24.4 million in subordinated notes held by John Hancock Mutual Life.
